text: Ethics in AI is an important topic today. AI systems can be biased if they are trained on unfair data. This can lead to unfair decisions in areas like hiring or banking. To make AI fair, developers must check their data carefully. Privacy is another key concern, because AI often collects personal information. Companies should protect user data and use it responsibly. Transparency matters too: people should understand how AI makes decisions. Finally, responsible AI development means building systems that respect human values and do not cause harm. Everyone involved, from developers to governments, must work together to make sure AI is used in an ethical way.
